data.title: CN Energy Group Files March 2026 Interim Results, Revealing Weaker Balance Sheet
data.description:
CN Energy Group ( (CNEY) ) has provided an announcement.

On September 18, 2026, CN Energy Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026, integrating these results into its existing shelf registration on Form F-3. The filing shows total assets declining to about $67.8 million from $107.3 million as of September 30, 2025, with a sharp drop in current assets driven by the reversal of an acquisition-related receivable, while revenues for the half-year rose modestly to $17.7 million, indicating tighter liquidity but ongoing operating activity.

data.description:

data.title: Moleculin Biotech Faces Nasdaq Delisting Risk After Notice
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Moleculin Biotech ( (MBRX) ).

On September 15, 2026, Moleculin Biotech disclosed that it had received a Nasdaq Staff Determination Letter stating its common stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement over the 30 business days from July 31 to September 11, 2026. Because the company conducted a 1-for-25 reverse stock split on December 1, 2025, it is not eligible for the standard 180-day grace period and faces an elevated risk of delisting.

Moleculin plans to request a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which would stay any suspension or delisting actions while the process is underway and allow its shares to continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company cautioned that there is no assurance its continued listing request will be granted or that it will regain and maintain compliance with Nasdaq’s minimum bid price and other listing requirements, creating uncertainty for shareholders and access to capital markets.
